title: St. Gertrude the Great, Virgin
subtitle: Optional Memorial · Rev 1:1-4; 2:1-5; Lk 18:35-43
text: At 25, St. Gertrude, a nun of Helfta in Germany, saw that her studies had crowded out her first love. Christ called her back, and she became a great mystic of his Heart. Today's first reading asks the same of us: return to the love you had at first.
imageAlt: Painting of St. Gertrude in a black Benedictine habit with an abbess's staff and palm, the Christ Child shown in her heart, her hand on an open book beside a quill
